description: Grachtengordel-Zuid double-width patrician houses (dubbele huizen) of 1660-1740 and their 18th-19th c. refrontings (Herengracht 468-520 in the Golden Bend, Keizersgracht 596 and 604): 10-16 m fronts of five axes, dark brown brick or painted black, a stone souterrain under a bel-etage reached by a centre stoop, white-framed sash windows diminishing up the front, a sandstone frieze cornice (often under a balustrade or a crest)

match.note: Herengracht 518-520 and 468-480 (2023-02/03 strips): five axes with the door on the centre axis over a double stoop; storey grid as the single canal house (souterrain 2.3-2.7 m, bel-etage 4.3-5.3 m, then 3.2-3.9 m), frieze cornice tops at 18-19.5 m. Wide fronts only (10-16.5 m), so the single canal-house type never competes.

cornice.note: Herengracht 518 (167981), 472 (176762): frieze cornice with consoles, sky over it

cornice-dormer.note: a centre pediment dormer over the frieze cornice

cornice-crest.note: Herengracht 520 (168044): a carved crest over the centre axis of the frieze cornice (skyline rise 2.8 m, top 0.8 m); a flagpole or a statue reads the same on the skyline and is pinned to the plain cornice

stoop-door-centre.note: the stoop climbs to the bel-etage door on the centre axis over a stone souterrain with barred lights

rhythm.bays: 5 axes, the door on the centre axis
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: souterrain: 4 barred lights | bel-etage: 4 windows + centre door | upper: 5
rhythm.groundFloor: centre stoop to the bel-etage door over a stone souterrain
rhythm.roofline: sandstone frieze cornice, sometimes a balustrade or crest over the centre
schemaLimits: the centre door surround and the carved centre bay (Herengracht 520) are drawn as a plain door and windows
the stoop's iron railing and the attic balustrade are not drawn
the frieze cornice is drawn as a 2.4 m entablature (kit maximum); consoles, dentils and lettering are not drawn
one pane layout (two across, two up per sash) for every storey

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023-03-27: five axes, centre door over a double stoop, souterrain 0-2.4 m with barred lights, window rows bel-etage, two upper rows and a low top row, frieze cornice
strip.jpg 2023-02-27, 2x gridded crop: Herengracht 472, 14.9 m: souterrain 0-2.3 m, bel-etage windows 2.6-5.6 m, rows 8.0-10.4 and 11.0-13.2 m, cornice 13.9-15.0 m under a balustrade

notes: Eaves of these fronts are the TOP of the frieze cornice (the entablature hangs under the eaves); reviewer eaves pins with countStoreys give that line where 3DBAG reads lower
The bel-etage weight is 4.2 (measured 4.4-4.9 m on Keizersgracht 606-616): the compile gate holds every storey over the souterrain to 2.3-4.6 m, and at 18-19 m eaves a heavier weight crosses 4.6 m

2026-11-10 kit round (docs/reports/gg-zuid-strip-verdict-20261110.md): white frames 0.12 m (windowFrames), a painted door surround (0.22 m pilasters, 0.3 m cap) and 0.9 m stoop rails on the stoop ground. The strip shows the cornice 3-4 m tall, but that is the soffit stretched by rectification; 3DBAG and the frieze foot put the facade-plane entablature at about 2.4 m.

Not drawn yet: the modillion row (entablature.dentils). On Keizersgracht 616A and 610 the two end blocks of the first house of each run fail the GLB audit opening-outside check (0.03-0.05 m2 each, 18.4-18.8 m), even 0.7 m in from the party walls. Parked until the audit host wall behind the frieze is understood.
